title: Selected-proof fence: tracker-cut marker must not sit on the closing fence line
outcome: A selected evidence body rendered as a fenced block always closes its fence, even when the entry is marked cut by the tracker, so later host anchors stay visible; the fence renderer and the anchor parser share one fence rule, and the partial-window-copy test asserts anchor placement.
acceptance: Selected-proof fence: tracker-cut marker must not sit on the closing fence line is done
